mutations.name: the swap is a plain release without the re-class mark
mutations.find:
const placed = deps.store.get().reclassIfHeld(input.runId, from, () => undefined, { actor: SHEPHERD_ACTOR, headSha: input.head });
  return { reclassed: placed !== false };
mutations.replace:
deps.store.get().release(input.runId, { actor: SHEPHERD_ACTOR, headSha: input.head });
  return { reclassed: true };
kills: a run held because its changed files were unread at registration, read again at a CI read is unheld when the whole read finds a 900-line PR with no adversary touch, as its registration would have left it
